description.value: BC Liquor Store is a provincial government-operated off-licence retail outlet, one of 198 BCLIQUOR locations across British Columbia, selling wine, spirits, beer, ciders, and non-alcoholic beverages. This Burnaby location sits on Skyline Drive and carries the standard broad BCLIQUOR product range. It operates as a walk-in retail store with no on-site food service or cyclist support infrastructure noted.
